qualification.details: Project Associate I (Post 1): B.E./ B.Tech./ M.Sc./ M.Tech/ B.Pharm degree in any branch of Life Sciences from a recognized university. Project Associate I (Post 2): Master's in any branch of Life Sciences from a recognized university involving a dissertation/project on infectious diseases (bacterial or viral). Senior Project Associate (Post 3): Master's degree in mathematics/physics from a recognized University with at least four years post-qualification research experience OR Ph.D. in Mathematics/Physics from a recognized University. Project Associate I (Post 4): B.E./ B.Tech or M.Sc./ M.Tech. degree in Mathematics/ Physics/ Computer Science/ Bioinformatics from a recognized university.

content_sections.heading: THSTI Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the THSTI Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download THSTI Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: THSTI Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Associate I (Post 1): B.E./ B.Tech./ M.Sc./ M.Tech/ B.Pharm degree in any branch of Life Sciences from a recognized university. Project Associate I (Post 2): Master's in any branch of Life Sciences from a recognized university involving a dissertation/project on infectious diseases (bacterial or viral). Senior Project Associate (Post 3): Master's degree in mathematics/physics from a recognized University with at least four years post-qualification research experience OR Ph.D. in Mathematics/Physics from a recognized University. Project Associate I (Post 4): B.E./ B.Tech or M.Sc./ M.Tech. degree in Mathematics/ Physics/ Computer Science/ Bioinformatics from a recognized university.

content_sections.heading: THSTI Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum age limit is 35 years for Project Associate-I (Post 1 & 2). Maximum age limit is 40 years for Senior Project Associate (Post 3). Maximum age limit is 35 years for Project Associate-I (Post 4). Age Relaxation: SC/ST: 5 years, OBC: 3 years, PwBD: 10-15 years, Central Govt servants: 5 years, Institute employees: service rendered, Ex-servicemen: service + 3 years. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for THSTI Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced by THSTI?
faq.answer: THSTI has announced a total of 4 vacancies for the post of Project Associate-I and Senior Project Associate. These positions are contractual in nature.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for THSTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Interested candidates can attend the interview directly without prior online application.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-I posts?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Project Associate-I posts ranges from Rs. 30,000/- + HRA to Rs. 42,000/- plus HRA, depending on the specific post and qualifications.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Associate-I posts?
faq.answer: Educational qualifications vary for each Project Associate-I post, including degrees in Life Sciences, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, or Bioinformatics, as specified in the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for THSTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Senior Project Associate post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Project Associate post is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q7. When are the walk-in interviews scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews are scheduled on different dates: 24th August 2026, 31st August 2026, 27th August 2026, and 10th September 2026, for different posts.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process typically includes a Written Test, Skill Test, and Interview. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for specifics.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the location of THSTI?
faq.answer: THSTI is located in Faridabad, Haryana, with the pincode 121001.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable).
